answer: In this PoA design, each identity locks bonded collateral, while signed evidence links coordinated equivocation. If k identities jointly equivocate, penalties scale quadratically, O(k^2), rather than linearly; upon detection, controlling a sybil swarm applies an exponential multiplier to capital loss through asymmetric depreciation and slashing. Splitting control into aliases is therefore uneconomic, whether disguised as fable, onyx, or marble.
